description: Automatically detect text language and switch between selected voices while NVDA reads multilingual content. Configure a synthesizer, voice, speech rate, pitch and volume for each language in NVDA Settings > Auto TTS for NVDA.
changelog: Bug fix release: fixed NVDA Add-on Store crash by migrating configuration out of the addons folder, resolved mixed-language speech deadlock where secondary language was dropped after English, and optimized activity log file size.
